// Format data for Airtable write
const d = $input.first().json;

const fs = d.factor_scores || {};
const fe = d.factor_evidence || {};

return [{
  json: {
    'Raw Input': d.raw_message || '',
    'From Email': d.from_email || '',
    'Source': d.source || '',
    'Enquiry Category': d.enquiry_category || '',
    'Sender Type': d.sender_type || '',
    'Sender Name': d.sender_name || '',
    'Programme Name': d.programme_name || '',
    'Programme Topic': d.programme_topic || '',
    'Age Range': d.target_age_range || '',
    'Location': d.location || '',
    'Format': d.format || '',
    'Fee Text': d.fee_text || '',
    'Fee Numeric': d.fee_numeric || 0,
    'Delivery Preference': d.delivery_preference || '',
    'Timeline': d.timeline || '',
    'Contact Email': d.contact_email || '',
    'Intent': d.intent || '',
    'Summary': d.summary || '',
    'Missing Fields': (d.missing_fields || []).join(', '),
    'Processing Status': d.processing_status || '',
    'Confidence Level': d.confidence_level || '',
    'Validation Flags': (d.validation_flags || []).join(', '),
    'Priority Score': d.score || 0,
    'Priority Tier': d.tier || '',
    'Score Breakdown': `Fit: ${fs.fit_to_succeed || 0}/25, Value: ${fs.value_and_actionability || 0}/25, Completeness: ${fs.completeness || 0}/20, Contact: ${fs.contactability || 0}/10, Strategic: ${fs.strategic_signal || 0}/20`,
    'Score Rationale': `Fit: ${fe.fit_to_succeed || 'N/A'}. Value: ${fe.value_and_actionability || 'N/A'}. Completeness: ${fe.completeness || 'N/A'}. Contact: ${fe.contactability || 'N/A'}. Strategic: ${fe.strategic_signal || 'N/A'}.`,
    'Reply Questions': (d.reply_questions || []).join('; '),
    'Next Action': d.action || '',
    'Action Note': d.action_note || '',
    'Needs Review': d.needs_review || false,
    'Draft Follow-Up': d.reply_draft || 'NO_RESPONSE',
    'Timestamp': d.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
    // LLM Evaluation fields
    'Eval Status': d.eval_status || '',
    'Eval Spam': d.eval_spam ? d.eval_spam.verdict : '',
    'Eval Institution': d.eval_institution ? d.eval_institution.verdict : '',
    'Eval Fee': d.eval_fee ? d.eval_fee.verdict : '',
    'Eval Audience': d.eval_audience_fit ? d.eval_audience_fit.verdict : '',
    'Eval Red Flags': (d.eval_red_flags || []).join('; '),
    'Eval Overrides': (d.eval_overrides || []).join('; '),
    'Eval Confidence': d.eval_confidence || '',
    'Rule Score': d.eval_rule_results ? d.eval_rule_results.rule_score : (d.score || 0),
    'Rule Tier': d.eval_rule_results ? d.eval_rule_results.rule_tier : (d.tier || ''),
    'Rule Action': d.eval_rule_results ? d.eval_rule_results.rule_action : (d.action || ''),
  }
}];
